features.featureTitle: Add a clickable Instagram icon/link pointing to https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw== in the website footer (and optionally in the header/navigation). The link must open in a new tab. Ensure it is visible on all pages.
